verdict.rationale: Supabase documents several first-party sandbox paths. Branching creates separate environments and isolated per-PR preview environments for testing changes "without affecting your production setup". The CLI runs the entire stack locally, including a local MCP server at localhost:54321/mcp. The MCP docs explicitly recommend branching for testing "in a safe environment before merging them to production", backed by branch create/reset/merge tools. Community reports on local development are mixed (one team couldn't get it working, another found it easy), which lowers quality but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: the MCP branching tool group is still experimental, there is no independent hands-on corroboration that branching keeps production data isolated, and the community reports local-development friction.
